column_description: A CHAR(12) primary key uniquely identifying each account record (e.g., 'AC1234567890').
A VARCHAR(14) field holding an external-facing or system-defined account identifier (e.g., 'ACC2686094').
An 8-character field indicating which platform ID the account is associated with (e.g., 'PL784').
An enum (PlatformType_enum) describing the platform type (Microblog, Social Network, Video Platform, Forum).
A DATE indicating when the account was created (e.g., '2025-02-20').
A SMALLINT showing the account’s age in days since creation (e.g., '45').
An enum (AccountStatus_enum) capturing the account status (Active, Deleted, Suspended, Dormant).
An enum (AccountType_enum) labeling the account type (Personal, Bot, Hybrid, Business).
An enum (VerificationStatus_enum) describing the verification state (Unverified, Pending, Failed, Suspicious).
